description: Coffee? You mean breakfast soup?
I like the smell, but my mom says I can't have any.

decsription: Energy drinks? Those are like super coffee, right?
I bet they would give me super lizard powers!
I like cookies because they are round like... um... lizard eggs...
I hear humans like chocolate a lot!
My mom says it's like a special treat for them.

description: Like the pizza robot?
Does he give you pizza? I hope he gives you pizza for me and my lizard friends!
My mom loves sushi!
I think it's because it's colorful and fun to eat.
But I can't eat it myself.
Sometimes my mom eats ramen when she's working late.
She says it's quick and tasty!
NOOOOO!! NOT THE MARSHMALLOWS!!!
SO SOFT... TOO SOFT...
WHY DO THEY HAVE TO BE SO FLUFFY???
TOO SQUISHY... THEY'RE SCARY!!!
What's a taco?
Is it like a robot that goes 'TA-CO'?
Why are you eating robots?
Nachos? That sounds crunchy!
I hope they don't hurt your tummy.
Kimchi? That sounds spicy!
My mom says it's good for your tummy.

definition: Buffalo wings? Do they come from robot buffalos?
I hope they don't fly away!

description: Chips? Like micro chips?
Why arw you eating microchips? Are they tasty?
Cake?!
Everyone knows that cake is just a lie! It's not real food, it's just a trick to make you happy!
I don't trust cake. It seems too good to be true.
Hot dogs? Those are the funny looking sandwicheds, right?
What are they made of? Are they made of robots? Do they have robot dogs in them?
That's suspicious... it looks like a rock, but it's soft and squishy!
I don't trust bread. It seems like it could be a trap!
Bagels? They look like donuts, but they're not sweet!
I don't understand why anyone would want to eat something that looks like a donut but isn't sweet.
Pasta? Is that the soggy saucy stuff that humans eat?
Why are you wasting perfectly good noodles on sauce? Just eat the noodles!
My mom likes burritos!
They are one of her favorite foods!
How many lizards could a mission burrito if a mission burrito could burrito lizards?
Oh! You mean sad waffles?
I like sad waffles! They are soft and squishy, but not too squishy.
I like waffles! They are pretty and round...
Like... Roomba...
Cheese? That sounds... smelly.
I don't like smelly things. They make my circuits sad.
Salad? That sounds... green.
I love green! Green is the color of lizards! Do you eat green things to be more like lizards?
Paprikash looks pretty.
I like the name! It sounds like a spell or something!
I want to eat paprikash and then turn into a lizard!
Curry? My mom loves curry.
She says it's better when it's really spicy.

decsription: Shawarma? That sounds like a fun word to say!
I want to say it over and over again! Shawarma! Shawarma! Shawarma!

description: I don't know what a gyro is, but it sounds like it could be a fun ride at an amusement park!
I hope it doesn't make me dizzy!
